description: This source file provides a React hook and utility functions to perform progressive batch processing of items, such as expanding tree nodes, in a way that maintains UI responsiveness. It includes a utility function to create a controller that applies work in batches using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, along with a React hook wrapper to integrate this functionality into React components.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller that manages progressive batch processing of items, calling applyBatch on each batch, and providing progress callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch expansion, wrapping around createProgressiveExpandController to provide start, cancel, progress, and status states.
